method: Shipped mesh and materials, native-resolution GPU silhouette, fixed V2 cameras. Both masks are filled to their external contours. Symmetric outer-contour distance in pixels. Orbit foreground uses the manufacturer alpha. The seven JPEG foreground masks estimate the visible exterior by color, texture and a hand-traced lower boundary separating cast shadow. These seven masks are approximate. Cropped image borders are excluded from wheel-view distances. The shaded pass uses the production studio materials and lighting, with the floor hidden. The transparent overlay combines the independently measured outer boundary with visible tonal edges.

frames.label: Front-left 25°
frames.note: The near front tire, left headlamp and outer splitter align in this front-quarter projection. The outline measurement covers the full car.

frames.label: Front-left 36°
frames.note: Check the left front arch, headlamp tip and nose against the outside boundary. Reflections across the door remain lighting dependent.

frames.label: Front-left 48°
frames.note: The two wheel locations, nose overhang and rear wing establish this front-left silhouette. The door inlet can be compared in the shaded render.

frames.label: Front-left 60°
frames.note: The front-left wheel, splitter end and greenhouse follow the general contour. Small differences remain in the front-intake shading.

frames.label: Front-left 73°
frames.note: The side angle exposes the lower rocker and the hatch contour. Inspect the height changes along the rear glass and the lower rear bumper.

frames.label: Front-left 84°
frames.note: The left broadside wheelbase anchors the wing check. Its top falls on the same image row as Chevrolet’s tip. The aft edge is about five pixels forward.

frames.label: Left broadside
frames.note: The two axles define the left profile. Follow the outline over the hatch and under the rear bumper to see where the mesh departs from the source.

frames.label: Rear-left 71°
frames.note: The rear overhang is photo-constrained in the outline. The broad bright reflection in Chevrolet’s side door narrows differently toward the inlet in the model.

frames.label: Rear-left 60°
frames.note: The rear tire and rocker meet the lower body at visibly different edges. This view retains one of the larger contour residuals on the orbit.

frames.label: Rear-left 47°
frames.note: The left rear tire, wing tip and rocker track the contour. Surface detail in the grille above the diffuser has coarser separation.

frames.label: Rear-left 36°
frames.note: The wing supports, outside tail-lamp edges and rear wheel align broadly. The recess around the four central tips is approximate.

frames.label: Rear-left 24°
frames.note: The rear lamps, axle line and tip of the left quarter line up across the split. Use the outline to inspect the small remaining endplate offsets.

frames.label: Rear-left 11°
frames.note: The rear width and wing span can be read against the source. The central exhaust photograph establishes four outlets; their depth is less certain.

frames.label: Rear square
frames.note: The upper wing spans approximately x=417 to 1065 in the rendered rear view; Chevrolet spans x=421 to 1066. The central exhaust and diffuser surfaces are less closely matched.

frames.label: Rear-right 13°
frames.note: The near-square rear view supports the width of the rear fascia, both tires and the lamp band at the measured outline precision.

frames.label: Rear-right 25°
frames.note: The wing, near rear arch and diffuser outer corner establish the right rear-quarter silhouette. Internal diffuser depth is approximate.

frames.label: Rear-right 37°
frames.note: The near wheel and main lower bumper follow the right rear-quarter contour. Internal exhaust and diffuser shapes have weaker registration.

frames.label: Rear-right 49°
frames.note: The lower bumper and rear tire are anchored by the right side and wing tip. The intake and brake appearance differ from the reference inside the silhouette.

frames.label: Rear-right 61°
frames.note: The side inlet mouth is recessed, with a clear upper blade. The highlight across the lower door and rocker differs from the Chevrolet finish.

frames.label: Rear-right 72°
frames.note: The right rear wheel and endplate follow the reference contour. The hatch louvers and glossy door highlight remain easier to distinguish in the photograph.

frames.label: Rear-right 85°
frames.note: The opposite broadside confirms the wing adjustment. The two upper edges are one pixel apart in height, and the aft tip has the same image column.

frames.label: Right broadside
frames.note: Both right wheels sit against the source wheelbase. The roof and hatch details remain more prominent in the model’s upper outline.

frames.label: Front-right 72°
frames.note: The right door and front arch establish the side profile. The shaded panel treatment and the front intake return differ at oblique incidence.

frames.label: Front-right 59°
frames.note: The front-right angle supports the overall arch placement, front overhang and cabin roofline. Check the intake and lamps separately for surface detail.

frames.label: Front-right 47°
frames.note: The right headlamp tip, front tire and high wing establish the front quarter. Shading across the door and intake differs from the reference.

frames.label: Front-right 35°
frames.note: The nose, windshield perimeter and right arch sit close to their photographed positions. The rear wheel is partly occluded at this angle.

frames.label: Front-right 23°
frames.note: The nose and outer corners of the splitter provide a clear comparison at this front-right angle. Lighting changes the apparent depth of the grilles.

frames.label: Front-right 11°
frames.note: The two headlamps, windshield and high rear wing are visible. The outer outline is more tightly constrained here than the recessed grille surfaces.

frames.label: Front square
frames.note: The straight-on front view establishes the centered nose, hood opening and paired lamps. The splitter and wing edges set the outer width.

frames.label: Front-left 14°
frames.note: The front-left view shows both corner intakes and the near headlamp. The visible front outline is the scope of the numerical check.

frames.label: Overhead plan (ZTK)
frames.note: The overhead image places the nose at the top and the high wing at the bottom. It shows the roof, engine cover and wing footprint clearly. Few shared landmarks constrain camera height or pitch independently.

frames.label: High front-left 3/4 (ZTK)
frames.note: The hood badge, wheel centers and wing corner constrain the elevated left view. Six held-out landmarks have a median reprojection error of 5.94 pixels at native resolution.

frames.label: Studio front-left 3/4 (ZTK)
frames.note: The left lamp, front grille and near tire establish the nose in the 2500-pixel view. The intake mesh, glazing and lighting still differ inside the outer contour.

frames.label: Studio left oblique (ZTK)
frames.note: The outer endplate top is within two native pixels of Chevrolet’s tip. Both wheel centers and the near sill anchor this oblique view. The door reflection and rim finish differ.

frames.label: Studio rear-left 3/4 (ZTK)
frames.note: The outer endplate crest is within one native pixel of Chevrolet’s tip. The near rear tire and lamp band establish the angle. The diffuser surface and exhaust tips remain approximate.

frames.label: Studio rear-right 3/4 (ZTK)
frames.note: The right rear-quarter image reveals the endplate and the upward turn of the sill behind the side inlet. The lower diffuser and the door highlight remain different.

frames.label: Front wheel, Alcon brake & side inlet
frames.note: The close-up exposes the rim, drilled rotor, fender lip and right-side intake. The camera and approximately 34° of front steering were inferred together. The tyre, spoke shapes and lower rocker still differ, and the rear hub is partly occluded.
The underbody drawing locates the engine, transaxle, tunnel battery and front electric drive. Housing, pipe and cable shapes are approximate.
The front three-quarter LT7 image establishes the intake, block and turbocharger package. Cast surfaces and small plumbing remain approximate.
The housing profile, turbos and plumbing are visible in the side reference. The model simplifies the cast transitions, pipe bends and fasteners.
The flywheel view locates the rear face of the LT7. Fastener placement and the depth of individual castings have limited evidence.
The installed engine view shows the intake beneath the hatch. Wiring, clamps and bay finishes differ across the two images.
The cutaway shows the approximate shaft and clutch arrangement; individual tooth geometry, cuts and concealed hardware have limited source coverage.
The transaxle reference supplies casing and axle orientation. Vehicle variant, fixture and housing detail limit the visual registration.
The component reference locates the front e-AWD housing and axle interfaces. Cast detail and interior gear dimensions are approximate.
The tunnel housing and module rows can be compared with the engineering cutaway. The exposed module construction and enclosure cross-section are illustrative.
The brake reference establishes rotor and multi-piston caliper layout. Drill pattern, lettering and surface finish remain approximate.
The Jet Black driver view establishes wheel, display and console arrangement. The instrument artwork, upholstery and physical controls are reconstructed.
The three-screen close-up shows the relative display locations. The graphic artwork, wheel position and panel reflections differ from the source.
The Blade Silver coupe shows the plan shape of the glass and cooling openings. Paint and rear aero differ from the Torch Red high-wing studio configuration.
The Nürburgring photo provides a real-car check on the wing and overall proportions. Yellow paint, wheel configuration, lighting and track perspective differ.
The 6000-pixel accessory-drive image exposes the belt route and the arrangement of pulleys. The model simplifies individual fittings and auxiliary supports.

overview: 30 turntable angles at 1500 × 750 and seven Chevrolet studio images at 2500 × 1407. The average silhouette overlap is 96.7% on the turntable and 96.4% on the larger images. The studio also offers 15 component, cabin and alternate-configuration comparisons.
coverage: 27 verified for the visible features noted, 8 with further fitting needed, 17 limited comparisons and 0 pending; 43 further images are retained as reference material.
